description: This file contains implementation of a function to hoist packed convolution parameters from specific quantized convolution modules to the parent module in a PyTorch JIT graph, including traversal of the graph and renaming attributes.

methods.name: hoistConvPackedParams
methods.description: Hoists packed parameters from a convolution module to the root module, renaming attributes to ensure uniqueness.

methods.name: HoistConvPackedParams
methods.description: Traverses the JIT graph to find quantized convolution modules with packed parameters and hoists these parameters to the parent module.
